svg.aria-label: Direction predictor, path history, tables and recovery
svg.text: Direction predictor, path history, tables and recovery
What is measured is the history update rule and the table layout. The provider logic is standard TAGE. The recovery mechanism is a conjecture.
Six tagged tables, indexed by PC and history
layout measured, lengths and widths ours
taken folds PC 2 to 24 and offset
indirect folds PC and target bits
shifted left one place per taken branch
● Not-taken branches leave the history still.
○ Both end with h2, so only the PC index tells them apart.
+ Rewind keeps about 1 Kb, 144 x 7 b.
~ Copies keep about 14 Kb, 144 x 100 b.
+ A probe could mispredict once per N taken branches.
+ Rebuild cost grows with N under rewind, not under copies.
? No probe has separated the two yet.
● The index is PC 18:2 XOR a fold of the history.
● PC bit 6 splits the block, two branches a lookup.
● Each table has its own associativity.
● No privilege or process tag is on an entry.
says where the last calls went
one site, many targets, told apart
no ASID or EL on an entry
3 fetch moves at once, older branches or not
● One path history indexes the direction and indirect tables.
~ inferred: patent reading or author reasoning
